entry.title: How to Read an AI Product's Changelog Before You Commit to It
entry.summary: The changelog is the most honest document a software vendor publishes. Marketing copy is optimized for acquisition. Documentation is optimized for onboarding. The sales deck is optimized for closing. The changelog is written for existing users who need to know what changed and why. It is the one document that, if written honestly, has no audience other than people who are already relying on the product. For enterprise AI tools specifically, the changelog is one of the most valuable due diligence resources available before signing. entry.summary: Audit Trails Make Systems Easier to Trust is a practical operating principle, not a slogan. The useful version of analytics, automation, and software operations is usually quieter than the marketing version.
